Conditions:

(i) If the first element is an odd number and the last element is an even number, the codes for these two (the first and the last elements) are to be interchanged.

(ii) If the second element is a symbol and the fifth element is an even number, the codes for these two (the second and the fifth elements) are to be interchanged.

(iii) If the third element is a number and the fourth element is a symbol, both these elements (the third and the fourth elements) are to be coded as Y.
